'''''The Eye of the Empire''''' was an [[Music/Legends|opera]] celebrating the supposed superiority of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] piece was commissioned during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]] by a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who [[Death/Legends|died]] long before<ref name="Ascension" /> [[44 ABY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]'' is set in [[44 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref>

By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="ERC" /> memories of the opera had faded, and few individuals admitted that they had listened to it given its theme of [[Humanocentrism]] that claimed [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]] species would be happiest under Human subjugation. However, its arias were regarded as some of the finest ever composed by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Sallinor Parova]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], who sympathized with its theme of [[speciesism]] and felt that the decreased appreciation for ''The Eye of the Empire'' was a shame. When preparing to [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]], she hummed along to a recording of her favorite aria from the piece in her [[Parova's apartment|apartment]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] until she muted the music to receive a sudden call from [[Rynog Asokaji]], the [[Aide/Legends|aide-de-camp]] to Parova's [[Chief of Naval Operations|superior]], Admiral [[Nek Bwua'tu]].<ref name="Ascension" />

==Behind the scenes==
''The Eye of the Empire'' was introduced in the eighth volume of the ''[[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi]]'' novel series, [[Christie Golden]]'s [[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension|''Ascension'']], published in [[2011]].<ref name="Ascension" />
